moat_against: Americas is ~71% of revenue and is in decline: comparable sales -12% and revenue -8% in Q2 FY2026; core leggings sales down ~20% as silhouettes shifted away from the franchise product
Alo Yoga and Vuori are taking the premium customer with the same community playbook lululemon pioneered; reported US athleisure share down ~10pp to 43.9%
Product execution failures (pulled 'Get Low' leggings) and brand-sentiment damage in China (Great Wall campaign backlash) hit the fit/quality reputation the premium rests on
Leadership vacuum and governance fight: CEO departure, interim co-CEOs through 2026, founder Chip Wilson proxy battle; incoming CEO Heidi O'Neill's plan is unproven
Premium discretionary price point ($118 leggings) is exactly what consumers defer when budgets tighten — no cost or price moat underneath the brand
moat_for: Proprietary technical fabrics (Nulu, Everlux) and fit reputation supporting premium pricing — gross margin 56.6% in the latest FY, 55-59% across the last six years
Returns on capital far above cost through a cycle: ROIC proxy 41.9% / 65.9% / 42.7% / 76.4% / 75.4% / 49.4% over the last six fiscal years (fundamentals.json)
Direct-to-consumer model (825 stores at Q2 FY2026 plus digital ~39% of Q2 revenue) — owns pricing, presentation and customer data, no wholesale dependence
International business still growing (international revenue +4% in Q2 FY2026 while Americas fell 8%) and a net-cash, no-funded-debt balance sheet that funds the turnaround without creditors
moat_justification: Historically elite franchise — ROIC proxy 42-76% over the last six fiscal years and gross margin 55-59% on proprietary fabrics (Nulu, Everlux), premium pricing and a direct-to-consumer store + digital model — but the moat is measurably eroding: Americas comparable sales -12% in Q2 FY2026, leggings revenue down ~20%, share ceded to Alo Yoga and Vuori, product misses, and a CEO transition after a founder proxy fight. A 5 (moderate/narrow) scores the franchise that exists today, not the one that compounded at 20%+.
name: lululemon athletica inc.
one_liner: Premium athleisure brand, moat 5/10 and eroding — at $97.76 it does not clear 15% on reset numbers (weighted IRR 11.7%, weighted IV@15% $72.45; bear case 9.3%); it clears the 15% hurdle only below ~$72.
